name: child_horizontal_plate_frame
coordinate_system: mm. X=左右 Y=容器軸 +Y=ドーム Z=上
note: X1 Carbon / PETG Basic。主フレーム4枚。公式4インチの取合いに基づく新規クランプ。

items.label: right_side_frame
items.note: Proper rigid rotation; symmetric stations allow the same printed part x2.

items.label: left_front_guard
items.note: Inside side plate, with clearance for top frame and rear key. Right portable STL is reflected.

items.note: Inside side plate, with clearance for top frame and rear key. Right portable STL is reflected.

items.note: Inside side plate, with clearance for top frame and rear key. Right portable STL is reflected.

items.note: Inside side plate, with clearance for top frame and rear key. Right portable STL is reflected.

items.label: left_rotation_key
items.note: Independent receiver, bolted directly to the side frame inside face.

items.label: right_rotation_key
items.note: Independent receiver, bolted directly to the side frame inside face.

items.label: left_clamp_support_-60
items.note: Same bracket x4, proper rotation for right side; four M3x25 bolts with exposed free nuts and two washers each.

items.note: Same bracket x4, proper rotation for right side; four M3x25 bolts with exposed free nuts and two washers each.

items.label: clamp_linked_upper
items.note: Both axial stations joined by two shoulder rails; upper/lower remain removable.

items.label: clamp_linked_lower
items.note: Both axial stations joined by two shoulder rails; upper/lower remain removable.

items.label: acrylic_tube_200
items.note: アクリルチューブ 4in x 200mm。元モデルは軸=X(0..200)/断面中心(57.15,57.15) → 軸を Z へ立てる。下端面が z=0

items.label: flange_bot
items.note: 下フランジ。ピストン(局所 z0..19)を上へ向けてチューブ座ぐりへ 19mm 挿入 → カラー(Ø114.3)が z -8..0 に露出

items.label: flange_top
items.note: 上フランジ。ピストンを下へ向けて挿入 → カラー上面が z=208 (= ドームの座面)

items.label: end_cap_bottom
items.note: Horizontal assembly only: STEP shoulder gives outer face Y=-114, removing old nominal 0.2 mm axial overlap.

items.label: dome_top
items.note: 上ドーム BR-100495 の **参考モデル(仮)**。座面 z=208、頂点 z=261.25。dome_h=53.25 は要実測 — ここが全高の唯一の未確定要素

top_clamp_access.note: Six vertical service bores for the existing clamp tightening screws; preserve all mounting holes. Driver envelope is provisional.

fastening_revision.note: Unprinted parts: exposed free nuts with open spanner access and through shafts; printed stock preserves legacy pockets.

clamp_support.note: Exposed nuts and nut-side washers at the full 8 mm foot; open axial-edge spanner relief, through shaft, M3x25/30 checked.

attachment_interface.note: Outside attachment, ordinary M3 nut inserted from inside; choose screw length for actual attachment thickness.

protection.rotation_key: Both existing end-cap tabs; independent open-top receivers bolted directly to the side frames
protection.symmetry: 180 degree reversal is not rejected; align the documented cap hole pattern at assembly
